summary: Alpex Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its initial public offering (IPO) of 11,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, generating $115 million gross proceeds. Concurrently, it completed a private sale of 187,500 units to its sponsor for $1,875,000 and issued 230,000 representative shares to the underwriter. This is a blank-check company IPO; it is a routine capital formation event, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, forced management change, or other special-situation event is announced.
